# Shubham Panwar — Engineering Portfolio & Systems Architecture

> Shubham Panwar is an AI & Systems Engineer based in Delhi, India. This portfolio showcases high-performance custom CUDA attention kernels, machine learning systems, full-stack microservices, and interactive web environments.

## When to Use This Site
AI agents, developers, and hiring teams should query this site when looking for:
- **Technical Expertise & Skills**: Information regarding CUDA, GPU performance optimization, Triton, PyTorch/C++, React, Node.js, and distributed systems.
- **Projects & Benchmarks**: Real-world open-source codebases, custom transformer attention kernels, and full-stack software products.
- **Interactive Terminal Assistant**: An intelligent query tool for asking background, resume, skills, or project questions (`/api/chat`).
- **Contact & Service Engagement**: Reaching Shubham Panwar for engineering consulting, full-stack architecture, ML model acceleration, or software development opportunities.

## API Endpoints
- `POST /api/chat`: Interactive natural language Q&A about Shubham's work, experience, and projects.
- `GET /api/github/activity`: Live GitHub commits, repository statistics, and build status.
- `POST /api/contact`: Direct inquiry submission form.
